title: Normal Reference Attention and Defective Feature Perception Network for Surface Defect Detection (NDP-Net)
mechanism: Reference-based attention: features of a normal reference image repair the query's defective features; a multi-scale head segments the difference; built for textured surfaces.
adaptation: Reference-conditioned U-Net++: second input = a clean cell of the same source and layout (train) or same module (E1, if pool has it). Shared encoder, cross-attention at 1/8 and 1/16 from query to reference; decoder sees query and repaired features. Explicit 'normal here' for half-cut and scuff.
evidence: R: MVTec AD and DAGM textured defects, deployed in an industrial line; no thin-label evidence.
min_experiment: First verify E1 modules have pool cells. Arm: PF with reference branch; baseline: PF. Metric: E1 crack relF1@2, CV crack IoU. Kill: E1 gain < +0.03 or CV crack IoU drop > 0.012.
